title: Full Stack Engineer (Next.js & Node.js)
location: Remote from Pakistan; Australian AEST/AEDT business hours
description: Australian technology/consulting startup seeks a Pakistan-based remote full-stack engineer. Requires 3–4 years, Next.js/React/TypeScript, Node.js, REST APIs, PostgreSQL and MongoDB, a strong portfolio, independent feature ownership and clear communication. Stack also mentions Supabase/Firebase, GitHub, CI/CD and AI coding tools. AI/LLM integration and AWS/Azure are optional. Salary PKR 100,000–150,000/month paid in AUD; three-month probationary contract before possible long-term continuation. Australian AEST/AEDT business hours required. Apply with resume, GitHub and introduction; technical discussion follows. Funding date and active recruitment deadline not published on the reviewed page.
eligibilityEvidence: Official role explicitly states Pakistan-based, 100% remote. Hours are a separate unresolved commitment.
